newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser upgrades NatSteel.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser upgrades NatSteel.

text.p: Fraser Securities said on Monday it had upgraded to buy its recommendation for shares in Singapore steel firm NatSteel Ltd.
Fraser said in a report to clients it had "revised upwards" its recommendation on the current weakness of the stock and progress the company was making in its restructuring programme.
"We are now more convinced of NatSteel's ability to maintain its 1H96 earnings growth in 2H96," the report said. It did not specify its earlier recommendation.
The report said restructuring which cut direct labour costs -- 15 percent of production costs -- by 20-25 percent and a new 80-tonne furnace due to be operational by June 1997 were positive factors.
Fraser said it also expected strong growth from NatSteel's regional mills in Malaysia, the Philippines and China over the next two years.
Contributions from other group operations were also seen positive, the report said.

It said construction and chemicals were seen strong for the next two years, electronics was seen progressing and the resorts and properties division was expected to see improvements in rental income throughout 1997, with the prospect of some gains being booked in the second half of 1996.
